info.title: MendWise module API
info.description: SANDBOX — investigational, NOT FOR CLINICAL USE. Synthetic or public images only. Every response carries `regulatory_status: "investigational"`; production access starts after ARTG inclusion. Clinician review is enforced by the API: /measure, /tissue, /vlm-features and /run require an approval_id from /approve, bound to the image and the final mask.

ApiKey.name: x-api-key
ApiKey.description: Scopes: segment, approve, measure, tissue, vlm, evaluate, report, run, baseline, analyze, or *.

Envelope.description: Fields present on every successful response, alongside the endpoint's own fields.

degraded.description: A step degraded (e.g. a model was unavailable); `reason` says which.

post.description: POST /segment — draft wound outline (SAM 3; FUSegNet second opinion on foot wounds; HSV fallback).

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Replays the original response for 24 h.

body_zone.description: Body zone id, e.g. foot_left. Decides whether FUSegNet gives a second opinion.

schema.description: POST /segment — draft wound outline (SAM 3; FUSegNet second opinion on foot wounds; HSV fallback).
